How Points Work

How Points Work

There are 2 kinds of points. Every maintenance earns TK Points. They show in your account as “pending”, and they are released when you come in for your next maintenance.

TK Points

Yours to spend. 10 TK Points is £1, off all products and services.

Tier Points

1 Tier Point for each £1 you spend. 1,500 for Gold and 3,000 for Black.

What Counts as a Maintenance

A maintenance of £200 or more, at least 5 weeks after your last one for tapes, or 7 weeks for everything else. It fills a box on your Care Card, counts towards your tier and releases the points pending from your last one.

A smaller visit, or one sooner than that, is a top up. Top ups still earn points. They are added to what is pending and released with your next maintenance.

What You Earn

TK Points for every £1 you spend at a maintenance or a top up: 1 at Silver, 1.25 at Gold and 1.5 at Black. The maintenance itself, colour, a blow dry, a trim, Davines products, anything you buy that day. 10 TK Points is £1. New sets and hair pieces do not qualify for TK Points.

Come Back Earlier. Earn More

A £400 maintenance at Silver puts 400 TK Points pending. 10 TK Points is always £1 when you spend them. How many are released depends on how early you come back for your next maintenance.

Micro rings, micro bonds and wefts
Every 9 weeks400 TK Points£40
Every 11 weeks300 TK Points£30
Every 3 months200 TK Points£20
Tapes
Every 7 weeks400 TK Points£40
Every 9 weeks300 TK Points£30
Every 11 weeks200 TK Points£20

Toppers, Wigs and Clip-ins

Topper care, wig care and clip-in care work differently. There is no clock on them, so whenever you come in for your next maintenance your points are released in full.

Your Care Date

Your stylist sets it at the end of every visit, based on your preference, rather than a calendar. Toppers, wigs and clip-ins have no care date, because it depends on how much you wear the piece.

Optimal care cadence is:

Micro rings, micro bonds and wefts8 weeks
Tapes6 weeks

Worth Knowing

Pending points belong to your next maintenance

They are released when you come in for it, and the earlier you come, the more are released.

Booking is worth 100 points

Book your next visit at the desk on the day of your maintenance, and come in on that exact date. That is the only way to earn it, and it is released when you arrive.

How It Works

You move up a tier by coming in for your maintenance and earning Tier Points.

Gold

Fill a Care Card and earn 1,500 Tier Points.

Black

Fill a Care Card and earn 3,000 Tier Points.

Toppers, wigs and clip-ins

No Care Card needed, Tier Points only.

TK Points and Tier Points

TK Points

Yours to spend. 10 TK Points is £1, off all products and services.

Tier Points

1 Tier Point for each £1 you spend. 1,500 for Gold and 3,000 for Black.

Your Tier Year

Your tier year runs from 1 January to 31 December. You move up the moment you qualify, and keep your tier for the rest of that year and all of the next.

To stay in your tier, during that next year fill a Care Card and earn 1,250 Tier Points for Gold, or 2,500 for Black. If not, on 1 January you move to the tier your year supports.

ExampleReach Gold in June 2027 and you are Gold until 31 December 2028. Fill a Care Card and earn 1,250 Tier Points during 2028 to stay Gold for 2029.

What Counts as a Maintenance

A maintenance of £200 or more, at least 5 weeks after your last one for tapes, or 7 weeks for everything else.

Joining in 2026

You move up as soon as you qualify, even this year, and keep your tier until 31 December 2027. If you do not qualify in 2026, everything you spend from the day you join still counts towards 2027.

FAQs

FAQs

The things clients ask us most. If yours is not here, message the salon and we will answer it.

Your hair
Why do we encourage maintenance early?

Because it keeps your own hair and scalp healthy, and it is the closest thing to having a brand new set every single time. Your own hair grows a little over a centimetre a month and the rings travel down with it, so they start to show around 8 weeks. As the extensions grow out, your own hair gathers and tangles at the root. That makes it harder to wash your scalp properly and to brush through, and over time it puts strain on your own hair. Coming on time keeps your hair healthy and looking new, and it makes the appointment itself quicker and easier for both of us.

What happens at a maintenance appointment?

Come to us with your hair freshly washed. Your extensions come out, the rings are replaced and the ends are re-tipped, and the same hair goes back in. You walk out with what feels like a brand new set.

Your points
When should I come in to earn the most?

Come back earlier, earn more. Take a £400 maintenance at Silver. Micro rings, micro bonds and wefts: come in for your next maintenance within 9 weeks and it earns 400 TK Points, £40. Within 11 weeks, 300 TK Points, £30. Within 3 months, 200 TK Points, £20. Tapes: within 7 weeks, 400 TK Points. Within 9 weeks, 300. Within 11 weeks, 200.

How does the booking bonus work?

Booking your next visit before you leave lets us keep the time that suits your hair best and plan the diary ahead. To thank you for it, we add 100 TK Points. To earn them, book your next visit at the desk on the day of your maintenance, and come in on that date. A visit booked later, by phone or by email, or moved to another day, does not qualify.

If I pay with points, do I still earn?

You earn on the amount you pay in cash. Pay part of the bill with points and the rest in money, and the money part earns as normal.

Does a new set or hair piece earn points?

TK Points come from what you spend at a maintenance: the maintenance itself, colour, a blow dry, a trim, Davines products, anything you buy that day. A new set or a new piece does not qualify for TK Points, but you can spend your TK Points on one.

How does the Care Card work?

Every maintenance fills a box on your Care Card. Fill all 4 boxes and we add 500 points, worth £50, to your balance. A full card also counts towards Gold and Black.

What is a top up?

A visit under £200, or one sooner than 5 weeks after your last maintenance for tapes, or 7 weeks for everything else. It still earns points. They are added to what is pending and released with your next maintenance. A top up does not fill a Care Card box.

Do points expire?

After 24 months from the day they land, and we tell you 3 months before anything does. They are never taken away for anything you do.

How do I progress to the next Tier?

Everyone starts at Silver. Fill a Care Card and earn 1,500 Tier Points for Gold, or 3,000 for Black. Tier points are 1 for every £1 you spend with us, on anything. You move up the moment you qualify, and keep your tier for the rest of that year and all of the next. The How Tiers Work section has more details.

What do the different tiers give me?

More points on every maintenance, bigger discounts on colour and Davines, free colour, a wash and blow dry with your maintenance, birthday points and a Davines gift. Tier Perks shows exactly what each tier gives.

Anything else, message the salon from the Contact tab and we will answer it.

Prototype controls

Tier decides the card and the chips.

Type of client decides the Care Card, the rewards she is shown and her care date.

Where she is today decides what her pending points are worth.

State decides what Home shows.

Edit mode lets you change any text on any screen, offline. Your changes are kept until you close the tab.

What is in these wireframes

Rules of 22 September. Only a counted maintenance fills a Care Card box, counts towards a tier, earns the booking bonus and releases pending points. Top ups earn and add to what is pending. Tiers come from a full Care Card plus Tier Points, on a calendar year. Every figure comes from the CRM.

Every points figure carries its pound value and no number is worked out on the phone. Dates read 14 November. Day counts read in 26 days.

The home screen opens on the loop video, with the lockup over it and the greeting beneath.

Social sharing is in, on the referral code. Reviews still go to Google, Trustpilot or the salon only, per section 4.13.

Prices on Rewards are placeholders until the live price list is wired in. Topper Care and Clip-in Care do not exist as priced services yet.
